item.title: Democrats play race card as House passes bill to protect voter information, lower cost of state voter list
item.description: MONTGOMERY — Members of the Alabama House passed a bill Thursday aimed at protecting voter information while also lowering the cost to access the state's list of registered voters.Currently, Alabama's voter list can be purchased for 1 cent per voter, or roughly $38,000 total. item.title: Montgomery contracts with private Louisiana company for $1.45 million to handle minor traffic accidents
item.description: The City of Montgomery is contracting with a private Louisiana company to handle some accident investigations.TrafficServe is a startup civilian accident investigation company that will handle minor accidents in place of Montgomery Police officers. The company will provide three cars for civilian traffic accident investigators and two additional employees for eight hours a day, five days a week.
